strategy: US stock RTH Opening-Range liquidity sweep + VWAP + displacement + FVG

rules.sweep: after 10:00, sweep OR high/low by 0.05-1.50 ATR then close back inside
rules.displacement: within next 1-4 bars, body>=0.60 ATR, CLV>=0.70, close through sweep candle extreme
rules.vwap: displacement close must be on trade side of session VWAP
rules.fvg: classic 3-bar 15m FVG >=0.08 ATR; entry at midpoint first retest within 6 bars
rules.exit: 2R target or stop; otherwise flatten at 16:00 ET
rules.ambiguity: STOP before TP on same 15m candle
